name: Sunohara Nozomu
source:
Nozomu is the childhood friend of [url=/c57060]Shiori[/url]. As soon as he graduates, Nozomu will start living alone to go to university but having never lived alone until now, he doesn't know how to take care of himself completely, like doing the laundry, hanging out the laundry, making good meals...

It is when he returns from school one day that he confides his problems to Shiori who, having a few years more experience on the subject than he does, then offers to teach him to live alone by inviting him to live some time at home.
